mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% for 3 consecutive months triggers a monetary easing cycle, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite the trigger condition being met, or FEDFUNDS does not stay below 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 4.0% signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) during the trigger period, or UNRATE does not cross above 4.0% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite simultaneous growth in GDPC1 and INDPRO, or the proxies do not move in tandem.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS rates coupled with falling UNRATE signals a dual tightening-labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE, or the proxies do not move in tandem.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP growth exceeding 19,500 for three consecutive months signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite GDPC1 exceeding 19500 for 3 months, or the GDP growth does not remain above 19500 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising HOUST (demand) alongside falling FEDFUNDS rates signals easing monetary policy and strengthening demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite rising HOUST and falling FEDFUNDS, or the proxies do not move in tandem.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 110.0 triggers a strong supply signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite INDPRO exceeding 110.0, or the threshold is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL below 2.0% for the past 6 months signals persistent deflationary pressure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite CPIAUCSL remaining below 2.0% for 6 months, or the deflationary trend reverses.
